customer: Retired caller with a full-size SUV says he cant find his titel anywere and wants to know how to get a new one before his apointment.
agent: Customer asked how to replace a lost title in California. Explained per 'Getting a duplicate title in California' that California issues paper titles and a duplicate can be requested at any California motor vehicle office with photo ID and registration. Advised that the main offices print duplicates the same day, while by mail it takes 2 to 3 weeks. Reminded him to bring the duplicate to his appointment.
